articles.summary: Europe’s leading Bitcoin savings app set out to raise $2 million. Faced with exceptional demand — $26 million in investment pledges from over 25,000 people on the waitlist, a record in Europe — Bitstack expanded the round to $4.5 million. By bringing together over 8,000 investors, Bitstack has completed the largest crowdfunding round in the European Union.
articles.title: Bitstack opens its capital to the public and brings together over 8,000 investors: a record in the European Union
